mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM qa_answer a INNER JOIN qa_conversation c ON c.public_id = a.conversation_id WHERE c.public_id = #{id} AND c.owner_id = #{ownerId} AND c.deleted_at IS NULL AND a.status IN ('PENDING', 'RETRIEVING', 'QUERYING', 'GENERATING', 'CANCEL_REQUESTED')
